senses.gloss: f. (v. preced.) flake of wool, hatchelled wool.
units: Sabb. 50ᵃ יוצאין בפקורין ובצ׳ may go out with lint or a flake of wool (on a wound; oth. opin. in Tosaf.: with a wig); Tosef. ib. V (VI), 2 ובצוּפָּא (ed. Zuck. ובציפי צמר).

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:23">Tosef. Kil. V, 23</cite> <he>והציפה</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00327"><he>פּוֹקָרִין</he></cite>. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. VII, Par. 6 <he>יכול אף הצ׳</he> you may think the same law applies to raw wool (as to a woven garment); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:15">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> <he>הצירעה</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. m. (of <he>צֵיף</he>, <cite ref="R00216"><he>צוּף</he></cite>) <he>צִיפִּים</he>, <cite ref="R00220"><he>צוּפִּים</he></cite> (or <cite ref="R00220"><he>צוּפִים</he></cite>). Y. B. Kam. IX, beg. 6ᵈ <he>כשעשאו צו׳</he> when the thief changed the stolen wool by making flakes of it.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>מצינו … בלא צ׳ שמא יש צ׳ וכ׳</he> cleansing of wool is sometimes done without hatchelling it, but is hatchelling ever done without previous washing?—Esp. <he>צִיפֵּי צמר</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 48a">Sabb. 48ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 19a:11">B. Bath. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>בגיזי … ובצ׳ צמר</he> in shorn wool (before it is washed and hatchelled) or in hatchelled wool. Tosef. Sabb. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 732:1-4">Yalk. Num. 732</cite> <he>היה … בצִפִּין של צמר</he> he stamped upon it (the fire), and quenched it with hatchelled wool; a. fr.
